questions.explanation: 由上文可知作者对伦敦奥运会充满热情，想参与其中。因此他“不介意(didn't care)”即使自己只是在场馆外跳舞。A符合句意，表示“在乎，介意”。
questions.supplement:
A(care)：语境句：I really don't care what they think of me. 固定搭配：care about, care for
B(admit)：语境句：He admitted having stolen the money. 固定搭配：admit doing sth, admit to
C(doubt)：语境句：I doubt if he will keep his promise. 固定搭配：beyond doubt, without a doubt
D(know)：语境句：She knows exactly how to handle the situation. 固定搭配：know about, let sb know

questions.explanation: 后文提到在“水上运动中心(Aquatics Centre)”、涉及“5米深的池子(5-metre-deep pool)”以及将人从水里救出，由此推断作者申请的职位是“救生员(lifeguards)”。
questions.supplement:
A(coaches)：语境句：The team hired two new coaches this season. 固定搭配：head coach, sports coach
B(athletes)：语境句：Many athletes train for years to compete in the Olympics. 固定搭配：professional athlete, track athlete
C(lifeguards)：语境句：The lifeguard saved the drowning boy. 固定搭配：on duty lifeguard, beach lifeguard
D(firefighters)：语境句：Firefighters risked their lives to put out the blaze. 固定搭配：brave firefighter, firefighter gear

questions.explanation: 作者认为会有成千上万的人申请这个职位，因此他从未期望能够“收到回复(hear back)”。B选项符合此处逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(step away)：语境句：He decided to step away from the company for a while. 固定搭配：step away from, step away for a moment
B(hear back)：语境句：I applied for the job but haven't heard back yet. 固定搭配：hear back from sb, wait to hear back
C(show off)：语境句：He bought a sports car just to show off. 固定搭配：show off one's skills, show off to sb
D(sign up)：语境句：You can sign up for the course online. 固定搭配：sign up for, sign up online

questions.explanation: 后文提到了“淘汰赛阶段(knockout stages)”以及只有一次机会等测试环节，说明这是一个为期两天的“选拔/试训(trial)”。
questions.supplement:
A(routine)：语境句：Exercise has become part of my daily routine. 固定搭配：daily routine, break the routine
B(practice)：语境句：It takes a lot of practice to play the piano well. 固定搭配：in practice, out of practice
C(experiment)：语境句：They are conducting an experiment to test the theory. 固定搭配：do an experiment, conduct an experiment
D(trial)：语境句：He was hired on a six-month trial basis. 固定搭配：clinical trial, stand trial

questions.explanation: 破折号后面解释了具体情况：有淘汰阶段且只有一次机会，说明竞争十分激烈、气氛“紧张(intense)”。
questions.supplement:
A(dangerous)：语境句：It is dangerous to walk alone at night. 固定搭配：highly dangerous, potentially dangerous
B(simple)：语境句：The solution to this problem is quite simple. 固定搭配：simple life, plain and simple
C(intense)：语境句：The candidate faced intense competition for the job. 固定搭配：intense heat, intense pressure
D(valuable)：语境句：She offered some valuable advice on my career. 固定搭配：valuable experience, highly valuable

questions.explanation: 在第一轮中，那些“未能(failing)”潜入5米深池底的人被淘汰(were cut)了。failing to do sth表示未能做某事。
questions.supplement:
A(pretending)：语境句：He was pretending to be asleep when I walked in. 固定搭配：pretend to do, pretend that
B(intending)：语境句：She is intending to study abroad next year. 固定搭配：intend to do, intend for
C(failing)：语境句：Failing to prepare is preparing to fail. 固定搭配：fail to do, without fail
D(desiring)：语境句：Desiring a better life, he worked day and night. 固定搭配：desire to do, a strong desire

questions.explanation: 作者最初觉得自己没戏(never expected to hear back)，并且测试过程非常艰难。所以当最终通过时，他感到“难以置信(disbelief)”。
questions.supplement:
A(misfortune)：语境句：He had the misfortune to lose his job. 固定搭配：suffer misfortune, a great misfortune
B(disbelief)：语境句：She shook her head in sheer disbelief. 固定搭配：in disbelief, stare in disbelief
C(dishonesty)：语境句：He was fired for dishonesty and theft. 固定搭配：academic dishonesty, act of dishonesty
D(misunderstanding)：语境句：A simple misunderstanding caused the whole conflict. 固定搭配：clear up a misunderstanding, avoid misunderstanding

questions.explanation: 由but引出的后半句“运动员很重视我们”可知，前半句是在说网上有些人不以为然，将他们的工作“贬低(dismissed)”为世界上最简单的工作。dismiss sb as... 意为“把某人打发走/对某人嗤之以鼻并认定为”。
questions.supplement:
A(trusted)：语境句：I have always trusted her completely. 固定搭配：trust sb with sth, trust in
B(admired)：语境句：I really admired him for his courage. 固定搭配：admire sb for sth, deeply admire
C(discovered)：语境句：Scientists have discovered a new species of bird. 固定搭配：discover the truth, make a discovery
D(dismissed)：语境句：He dismissed her idea as totally unrealistic. 固定搭配：dismiss sth as, dismiss an employee

questions.explanation: 后一句提到“我曾得到过一顶英国队的游泳帽”，说明运动员不仅重视他们，有时甚至会“赠送礼物(gifted)”给他们。
questions.supplement:
A(gifted)：语境句：The wealthy businessman gifted a large sum of money to the charity. 固定搭配：gift sb sth, highly gifted (adj.)
B(assisted)：语境句：The doctor was assisted by two nurses during the operation. 固定搭配：assist sb with sth, assist in doing
C(bothered)：语境句：He wasn't bothered by the negative comments. 固定搭配：bother to do, can't be bothered
D(ignored)：语境句：She ignored his warnings and went out into the storm. 固定搭配：completely ignore, ignore the fact

questions.explanation: 句意：即使你是顶尖的外科医生，但如果不知道如何“正确地(correctly)”把人从水里拉出来，甚至在他们得到治疗前就已经造成伤害了。强调救生员救助手法的专业性和正确性。
questions.supplement:
A(correctly)：语境句：Make sure you spell your name correctly on the form. 固定搭配：answer correctly, guess correctly
B(immediately)：语境句：She answered the email almost immediately. 固定搭配：immediately after, respond immediately
C(gently)：语境句：He gently placed the baby in the crib. 固定搭配：speak gently, smile gently
D(hurriedly)：语境句：He hurriedly packed his bags and left. 固定搭配：leave hurriedly, hurriedly written

questions.explanation: 下文举例说“我记得曾救过一名头部朝前撞到池壁的运动员”，这是典型的“意外事故(accidents)”。因此选B。
questions.supplement:
A(wonders)：语境句：It's one of the seven natural wonders of the world. 固定搭配：do wonders, no wonder
B(accidents)：语境句：Traffic accidents frequently occur on this wet road. 固定搭配：by accident, traffic accident
C(changes)：语境句：We need to make some changes to the plan. 固定搭配：make changes, climate change
D(events)：语境句：The historical events shaped the country's future. 固定搭配：current events, sporting event

questions.explanation: 前文提到会遇到明星感到追星般的震撼(starstruck moments)，但紧接着That said(话虽如此)发生转折，说明当你坐在裁判/救生椅上时，你变得非常“专业(professional)”，会忘掉明星光环，专注于工作。
questions.supplement:
A(annoying)：语境句：It's really annoying when people interrupt me. 固定搭配：highly annoying, find sth annoying
B(painful)：语境句：Losing a loved one is a very painful experience. 固定搭配：painful memory, acutely painful
C(impressive)：语境句：Her presentation was highly impressive. 固定搭配：impressive performance, look impressive
D(professional)：语境句：She handled the difficult situation in a professional manner. 固定搭配：highly professional, professional career

questions.explanation: 根据后半句“检查每个运动员的动作，看是否有什么不对劲”，这说明救生员在脑子里进行的是“风险评估(risk assessments)”。
questions.supplement:
A(health warnings)：语境句：Cigarette packets carry severe health warnings. 固定搭配：issue health warnings, ignore health warnings
B(risk assessments)：语境句：The manager asked us to conduct comprehensive risk assessments. 固定搭配：carry out risk assessments, environmental risk assessment
C(safety rules)：语境句：All workers must strictly observe the safety rules. 固定搭配：follow safety rules, violate safety rules
D(work arrangements)：语境句：We need to discuss our flexible work arrangements. 固定搭配：flexible work arrangements, alternative work arrangements

questions.explanation: 前句说到“并非所有事都会在电视上播出”，说明看守泳池的工作是在“幕后(behind the scene / behind the scenes)”默默进行的。
questions.supplement:
A(behind the scene)：语境句：A lot of hard work goes on behind the scenes to make the show a success. 固定搭配：work behind the scenes, behind the scenes footage
B(at random)：语境句：The participants for the survey were chosen at random. 固定搭配：choose at random, pick at random
C(by chance)：语境句：I met my old classmate by chance at the mall. 固定搭配：meet by chance, happen by chance
D(in the spotlight)：语境句：The politician has been in the spotlight since the scandal broke. 固定搭配：step into the spotlight, steal the spotlight

questions.explanation: 结合上一句“不在电视上播出”及“幕后工作”，可知救生员的角色是不引人注目的、“未被看见的(unseen)”，但他们依然至关重要(matters)。
questions.supplement:
A(unexpected)：语境句：His sudden resignation was completely unexpected. 固定搭配：unexpected outcome, unexpected guest
B(undisturbed)：语境句：I need an undisturbed place to focus on my writing. 固定搭配：remain undisturbed, undisturbed sleep
C(unhurt)：语境句：Fortunately, everyone escaped from the burning car unhurt. 固定搭配：escape unhurt, remain unhurt
D(unseen)：语境句：Many unseen forces are shaping the economy. 固定搭配：unseen dangers, remain unseen

vocab_pack.definition_en: to feel very happy and enthusiastic about something that will happen
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，主语为 I，be 动词用 was；搭配介词 about 引出兴奋的对象。
vocab_pack.example_en: I am excited about the opportunity to study abroad.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我对出国留学的机会感到兴奋。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was excited about the London Olympics

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be involved in or included in something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语，跟在 wanted 后作宾语；be 为原形，part 前不加冠词。
vocab_pack.example_en: Every student wants to be part of the school team.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每个学生都想成为校队的一员。
vocab_pack.from_passage: wanted to be part of it

vocab_pack.definition_en: to look for information on the Internet
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作状语，表示伴随或方式；动词 search 后直接接副词 online。
vocab_pack.example_en: When you don't understand a word, you can search online for its meaning.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 当你遇到一个不认识的单词时，你可以上网搜索它的意思。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Searching online, I thought they might need lifeguards.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to think or decide that something will happen or is true
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词 Figuring 作状语，表原因或伴随；后接 that 宾语从句（that 省略）。
vocab_pack.example_en: I figure it will take about two hours to finish the work.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我估计完成这项工作大约需要两个小时。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Figuring there'd be thousands of applicants

vocab_pack.definition_en: to receive a reply from someone, especially after contacting them
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语作 expected 的宾语；hear back 为固定短语，back 为副词。
vocab_pack.example_en: I sent my application a week ago but haven't heard back yet.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我一周前提交了申请，但还没有收到回复。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I never expected to hear back.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be asked to go somewhere or do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 被动语态，一般过去时，主语 I；was invited to 后接地点/活动。
vocab_pack.example_en: She was invited to give a speech at the conference.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她被邀请在会议上发言。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was invited to a two-day trial

vocab_pack.definition_en: a test of someone's ability or performance, often for a job or selection
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词，前有复合形容词 two-day 修饰，作介词 to 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The football club held a trial for young players.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 足球俱乐部为年轻球员举行了一次试训。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a two-day trial at the London Aquatics Centre

vocab_pack.definition_en: a round in a competition where the loser is eliminated and cannot continue
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复数形式 stages，与 there were 搭配，表示存在多个淘汰阶段。
vocab_pack.example_en: The team advanced to the knockout stage of the tournament.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这支队伍进入了锦标赛的淘汰赛阶段。
vocab_pack.from_passage: there were knockout stages

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be unsuccessful in reaching a destination or achieving a goal
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作定语，修饰 the ones；fail to do 表示未做成某事，make it to 表示成功到达。
vocab_pack.example_en: If you fail to make it to the finish line, you are disqualified.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 如果你未能到达终点线，你就会被取消资格。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the ones failing to make it to the bottom of a 5-metre-deep pool

vocab_pack.definition_en: to come after something in time or order
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词 Followed 置于句首引起倒装，正常语序为 Skill exams and theory tests followed。这里表示被动态？实为主动意义的过去分词表顺序。
vocab_pack.example_en: A loud noise followed the explosion.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 爆炸之后是一声巨响。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Followed were skill exams and theory tests.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to succeed in a test or examination
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，主语 I，不及物动词，后不需要宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: He studied hard and finally passed the final exam.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他努力学习，终于通过了期末考试。
vocab_pack.from_passage: When I finally passed, I felt disbelief.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to experience a feeling of not believing something is true
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，felt 为 feel 的过去式；disbelief 为不可数名词，作宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: When she saw the result, she felt disbelief.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 当她看到结果时，她感到难以置信。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I felt disbelief.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to decide that someone or something is not important and treat them accordingly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，dismissed 为过去式；宾语 us，as 引出看待的方式（having...）。
vocab_pack.example_en: Don't dismiss his ideas as useless without thinking carefully.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 不要不经思考就把他的想法当作没用来打发。
vocab_pack.from_passage: some dismissed us as having 'the easiest job in the world'

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a job that requires very little effort or difficulty
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动名词短语作 as 的宾语，having 为 have 的动名词形式；the easiest 为形容词最高级修饰 job。
vocab_pack.example_en: Some people think teachers have the easiest job, but that's not true.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 有些人认为教师的工作最简单，但事实并非如此。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as having 'the easiest job in the world'

vocab_pack.definition_en: to consider someone or something important and treat them with respect
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，主语 Olympians，及物动词，后接宾语 us。
vocab_pack.example_en: We should value the time we spend with our family.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应该珍惜与家人在一起的时光。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Olympians valued us

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give something to someone as a gift, especially as a sign of appreciation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，及物动词，后接双宾语（间接宾语 us 直接宾语 swimming cap）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The champion gifted his medal to his coach.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 冠军把他的奖牌赠给了教练。
vocab_pack.from_passage: gifted us a Team GB swimming cap

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: pull somebody out of the water
vocab_pack.definition_en: to remove someone from a dangerous place or situation, especially water
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 把某人从……中拉出来（尤指水中救起）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语作 know how to 的宾语；pull 为原形，somebody 为间接宾语，out of 为介词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The lifeguard quickly pulled the drowning child out of the pool.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 救生员迅速把溺水的孩子从游泳池里拉了出来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: how to pull somebody out of the water correctly

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause harm or injury
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时，you've done 中 done 为过去分词；the damage 为宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: If you don't rescue correctly, you may do the damage before the doctor arrives.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 如果救援方式不当，你可能会在医生到达之前造成伤害。
vocab_pack.from_passage: you've done the damage before they even get treatment.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a very skilled and successful surgeon
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，前有不定冠词 a，在 you could be 后作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She is a top surgeon in the field of heart surgery.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她是心脏外科领域的顶尖外科医生。
vocab_pack.from_passage: You could be a top surgeon

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to say that unexpected and unfortunate events can occur, often implying need for preparedness
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，但原文用 did 强调；accidents 为复数主语，happen 为动词原形。固定表达，无需冠词。
vocab_pack.example_en: No matter how careful you are, accidents happen.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 无论多么小心，意外总会发生。
vocab_pack.from_passage: And accidents did happen.

vocab_pack.definition_en: with the head going first, especially into something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词，修饰 swimming（现在分词），描述动作的方式。
vocab_pack.example_en: The diver jumped headfirst into the pool.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 跳水运动员头朝前跳入泳池。
vocab_pack.from_passage: swimming headfirst into the wall

vocab_pack.definition_en: feeling very excited or amazed because you meet a famous person
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 见到名人而兴奋的；追星似的
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词，修饰名词 moments，作定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: I was so starstruck when I saw the movie star that I couldn't speak.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我见到那位电影明星时太激动了，以至于说不出话来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: There are starstruck moments.

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to introduce a contrasting point after a previous statement
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定短语，常置于句首，起转折作用，后接逗号。动词 said 为 say 的过去分词，这里无时态变化。
vocab_pack.example_en: The job is very challenging. That said, it's also very rewarding.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这份工作很有挑战性。话虽如此，它也非常有回报。
vocab_pack.from_passage: That said, it's very professional when you're in the chair.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give all your attention to a particular thing
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词短语作表语，与 be 动词（are）构成系表结构；focused on 后接动名词 making。
vocab_pack.example_en: Students should be focused on their studies during class.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学生在课堂上应该专注于学习。
vocab_pack.from_passage: you're so focused on making risk assessments

vocab_pack.definition_en: to evaluate potential dangers or problems in a situation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动名词短语作介词 on 的宾语；make 用 making 形式，risk assessments 为名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Before starting a project, we need to make risk assessments.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在项目开始前，我们需要进行风险评估。
vocab_pack.from_passage: focused on making risk assessments in your head

vocab_pack.definition_en: to appear correct or normal
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 看起来正常；看起来没问题
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，在 if 从句中作谓语，doesn't look right 是否定形式；look 为连系动词，right 为形容词作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Something doesn't look right with the engine; we should check it.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 发动机看起来有点不对劲，我们应该检查一下。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to see if anything doesn't look right.

vocab_pack.definition_en: out of public view; in the background (often used as 'behind the scenes' but here singular)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语，作表语；原文用单数 scene，常用复数 scenes，但此处保留原文形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: A lot of hard work goes on behind the scenes in any successful event.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 任何成功的活动背后都有大量的幕后工作。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Guarding pools is the stuff going on behind the scene.

vocab_pack.definition_en: the state of being prepared without making any noise or drawing attention
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，作句子主语；silent 为形容词修饰 readiness（不可数名词）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The security team maintained silent readiness throughout the event.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 安保团队在整个活动期间保持着无声的准备状态。
vocab_pack.from_passage: But our silent readiness represents the Games' true spirit

vocab_pack.definition_en: to stand for or be a symbol of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 readiness 为第三人称单数，所以动词加 s。
vocab_pack.example_en: The dove represents peace in many cultures.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 鸽子在许多文化中象征着和平。
vocab_pack.from_passage: represents the Games' true spirit

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be important or have significance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 every role 为第三人称单数，所以动词加 s；however unseen 为插入语。
vocab_pack.example_en: In this competition, every point matters.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在这场比赛中，每一分都很重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: every role, however unseen matters.

section_2_word_form.passage:
Renli Village in Ziyang City, Sichuan Province, Southwest China, is home to a digital nomad community founded by Ke Yu, a girl born in 2000. [56] village, just a half-hour drive from downtown, helps escape the pollution, traffic and city crowds. With a gentle mountain wind, the smell of freshly cooked coffee and newly baked bread, it is not hard to figure out [57] so many digital nomads have chosen to live and work here.
"Digital nomads" are generally individuals who, thanks to advances in communication infrastructure (基础设施), make income through the Internet independent of traditional office [58]. Ke is familiar with the trend.
In late 2023, while searching for a remote working location, Ke [59] a photo online of Renli Village with three unused buildings, which, with minimal adaptation, could [60] for offices, accommodations and even entertainment spaces for the community.
Many digital nomads are united by a shared desire, [61] is to escape the fast-paced and high-pressure life of big cities to work in scenic and cost-effective locations. But, besides this, what unique experiences can be offered? Ke had an idea.
Ke and her partners invited artists from around the world [62] 10 interconnected art pieces, providing visitors with a [63] distinctive artistic journey. Within the 2,000-square-meter shared office space in the community, facilities [64] three-dimensional printers, live-streaming rooms and studio lights are provided to meet the specific needs of the remote workers typically [65] careers such as creative design, programming and media.

questions.explanation: 前文已经提到了Renli Village，此处再次提到“这个村子”表特指，故填定冠词The。位于句首需大写。
questions.supplement: 正确形(The)：语境句：The book on the table belongs to my teacher. 固定搭配：in the morning, the same as。原词无特殊变形及搭配。

questions.explanation: 句意为：不难理解“为什么”有这么多数字游民选择在这里生活和工作。此处引导宾语从句且表示原因，故填why。
questions.supplement: 正确形(why)：语境句：I really don't understand why he left so early. 固定搭配：that is why, the reason why。原词无特殊变形及搭配。

questions.explanation: 此处意为“传统的办公环境”。setting作为“环境、背景”为可数名词，这里泛指各种传统办公室环境，用复数settings更符合语境。
questions.supplement: 正确形(settings)：语境句：The application allows you to customize your privacy settings. 固定搭配：in a rural setting, default settings。原词setting其它变形：set(v.) set up, set off。

questions.explanation: 句子时间状语为“In late 2023”，指过去发生的动作，故谓语动词用一般过去时encountered，意为“偶然遇到/看到”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(encountered)：语境句：We encountered numerous challenges during the expedition. 固定搭配：encounter difficulties, encounter resistance。原词encounter无特殊变形。

questions.explanation: 主语which代指三栋废弃建筑，与repurpose(重新改变用途)是被动关系。情态动词could后接被动语态的动词原形，故填be repurposed。
questions.supplement: 正确形(be repurposed)：语境句：These empty factories can be repurposed as modern art galleries. 固定搭配：repurpose sth for sth, be repurposed as。原词repurpose其它变形：purpose(n.) on purpose, for the purpose of。

questions.explanation: 逗号后为非限制性定语从句，先行词是“a shared desire”，在从句中作主语，故用关系代词which。
questions.supplement: 正确形(which)：语境句：He offered to help me, which was very kind of him. 固定搭配：in which, from which。原词无特殊变形。

questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配 invite sb to do sth (邀请某人做某事)，此处用不定式作宾语补足语，填to design。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to design)：语境句：They hired an architect to design their new house. 固定搭配：design sth for sb, be designed to do。原词design其它变形：designer(n.) fashion designer, designed(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 此处修饰形容词 distinctive (独特的)，需要用副词形式 truly，意为“真正地”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(truly)：语境句：It is truly an honor to be invited here today. 固定搭配：truly believe, yours truly。原词true其它变形：truth(n.) tell the truth, truthful(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 此处表示举例，“包括3D打印机等设施”，作介词使用，填 including (或者 like)。高考一空一词中 including 最为常见。
questions.supplement: 正确形(including)：语境句：The tour costs $100, including meals and tickets. 固定搭配：up to and including, not including。原词include其它变形：inclusive(adj.) all-inclusive, inclusion(n.)。

questions.explanation: 修饰前面的名词 remote workers，由于workers和pursue(追求、从事)是主动关系，故用现在分词 pursuing 作后置定语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(pursuing)：语境句：She is currently pursuing a master's degree in computer science. 固定搭配：pursue a career, pursue a goal。原词pursue其它变形：pursuit(n.) in pursuit of, pursuer(n.)。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be the place where something or someone is located or exists
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为一般现在时，第三人称单数 is，后接名词，表示村庄是数字游民社区的所在地。
vocab_pack.example_en: The ancient forest is home to many rare species.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这片古老森林是许多稀有物种的家园。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Renli Village ... is home to a digital nomad community

vocab_pack.definition_en: to establish or create an organization, community, etc.
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为过去分词形式 founded，与 by 一起构成被动语态，作后置定语修饰 community，表示被柯宇创建。
vocab_pack.example_en: The university was founded in 1892.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这所大学成立于1892年。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a digital nomad community founded by Ke Yu

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have been born in a particular year or place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中过去分词 born 作后置定语修饰 girl，表示该女孩出生于2000年。
vocab_pack.example_en: Albert Einstein was born in Germany in 1879.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦1879年出生于德国。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a girl born in 2000

vocab_pack.definition_en: a journey of about 30 minutes by car
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中作名词短语，作表语，表示村庄距离市中心半小时车程。
vocab_pack.example_en: The airport is a half-hour drive from the city center.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 机场距市中心半小时车程。
vocab_pack.from_passage: just a half-hour drive from downtown

vocab_pack.definition_en: to get away from a place or situation that is unpleasant or difficult
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中 help escape 为 help + 省略 to 的不定式结构，escape 为动词原形，作宾语补足语，表示帮助逃离污染、交通和人群。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many people escape the city noise by moving to the countryside.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多人通过搬到乡下来逃离城市的噪音。
vocab_pack.from_passage: helps escape the pollution, traffic and city crowds

vocab_pack.definition_en: recently prepared (usually of food)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为副词 freshly + 过去分词 cooked 组成的形容词短语，修饰 coffee，表示现煮的咖啡。
vocab_pack.example_en: The restaurant serves freshly caught fish every day.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家餐厅每天供应新鲜捕捞的鱼。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the smell of freshly cooked coffee

vocab_pack.definition_en: to understand or solve something after thinking
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为 it is not hard to figure out...，不定式短语作实际主语，figure out 为原形，后接 why 从句。
vocab_pack.example_en: It took me a while to figure out the answer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我花了一会儿才弄明白答案。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it is not hard to figure out why

vocab_pack.definition_en: because of; due to (often used to show a positive reason)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中引导状语，表示由于通信基础设施的进步，数字游民能够在线赚钱。
vocab_pack.example_en: Thanks to your help, we finished the project on time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 多亏了你的帮助，我们按时完成了项目。
vocab_pack.from_passage: thanks to advances in communication infrastructure

vocab_pack.definition_en: to earn money
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为 make income，动词原形，主语是 who（指 individuals），一般现在时第三人称复数，故用原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: Freelancers often make income through multiple channels.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 自由职业者通常通过多种渠道赚钱。
vocab_pack.from_passage: make income through the Internet

vocab_pack.definition_en: not influenced or controlled by something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为形容词短语 independent of，修饰 make income 的方式，表示收入不依赖于传统办公环境。
vocab_pack.example_en: The research should be independent of political influence.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 研究应该独立于政治影响。
vocab_pack.from_passage: independent of traditional office settings

vocab_pack.definition_en: to know something well
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为一般现在时，主语 Ke 第三人称单数，is familiar with 为系表结构，表示柯宇熟悉这一趋势。
vocab_pack.example_en: Students should be familiar with basic grammar rules.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学生应该熟悉基本语法规则。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Ke is familiar with the trend.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to try to find something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为现在分词 searching for，作状语，表示在寻找远程工作地点时的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: They are searching for a new office location.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们正在寻找新的办公地点。
vocab_pack.from_passage: while searching for a remote working location

vocab_pack.definition_en: to meet or experience something unexpectedly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为一般过去时 encountered，表示柯宇在网上偶然看到了一张照片。
vocab_pack.example_en: I encountered an old friend on the subway.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我在地铁上偶遇了一位老朋友。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Ke encountered a photo online

vocab_pack.definition_en: to adapt something for a different use
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为情态动词被动语态 could be repurposed，表示三栋建筑可以被改造用于办公、住宿和娱乐。
vocab_pack.example_en: Old factories can be repurposed into art galleries.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 旧工厂可以被改造成艺术画廊。
vocab_pack.from_passage: could be repurposed for offices, accommodations ...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be brought together by a common feeling or goal
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 被……团结在一起；因……而联合
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为一般现在时被动语态，are united by，主语 many digital nomads 复数，表示许多数字游民被共同的愿望联结。
vocab_pack.example_en: The team is united by a shared passion for science.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个团队因对科学的共同热情而团结在一起。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Many digital nomads are united by a shared desire

vocab_pack.definition_en: a common wish or hope that people have
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为过去分词 shared 作定语修饰 desire，表示共同的愿望，前面有 a，可数名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: A shared desire for peace brought the two sides together.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 对和平的共同愿望使双方走到了一起。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a shared desire

vocab_pack.definition_en: happening very quickly; with a lot of activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为复合形容词，修饰 life，表示快节奏的生活。
vocab_pack.example_en: She prefers a fast-paced work environment.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她更喜欢快节奏的工作环境。
vocab_pack.from_passage: fast-paced and high-pressure life

vocab_pack.definition_en: involving a lot of stress and demands
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为复合形容词，与 fast-paced 并列修饰 life，表示高压生活。
vocab_pack.example_en: Sales jobs can be very high-pressure.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 销售工作压力很大。
vocab_pack.from_passage: fast-paced and high-pressure life

vocab_pack.definition_en: giving the best possible profit or benefits in comparison with the money that is spent
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为复合形容词，修饰 locations，表示性价比高的地点。
vocab_pack.example_en: Solar energy is a cost-effective solution for remote areas.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 太阳能是偏远地区成本效益好的解决方案。
vocab_pack.from_passage: scenic and cost-effective locations

vocab_pack.definition_en: to provide special or distinctive things for someone to do or enjoy
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为疑问句结构 what unique experiences can be offered? 被动语态，offer 的过去分词 offered 表示被提供。但此处提炼主动搭配 offer unique experiences。
vocab_pack.example_en: The tour company offers unique experiences for adventure seekers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这家旅游公司为寻求冒险的人提供独特的体验。
vocab_pack.from_passage: what unique experiences can be offered?

vocab_pack.definition_en: to think of a plan or suggestion
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为一般过去时 had an idea，表示Ke想到了一个点子。
vocab_pack.example_en: Suddenly she had an idea that solved the problem.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 突然她有了一个解决问题的主意。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Ke had an idea.

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: invited artists from around the world to design
vocab_pack.definition_en: to ask someone politely to come or to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为一般过去时 invited，后接宾语 artists 和带 to 的不定式 to design，表示邀请艺术家来设计。
vocab_pack.example_en: The school invited a famous writer to give a speech.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学校邀请了一位著名作家来演讲。
vocab_pack.from_passage: invited artists from around the world to design 10 interconnected art pieces

vocab_pack.definition_en: connected with each other
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为过去分词作定语，修饰 art pieces，表示互相连接的艺术作品。
vocab_pack.example_en: The world's economies are highly interconnected.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 世界经济高度互联。
vocab_pack.from_passage: 10 interconnected art pieces

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: providing visitors with a truly distinctive artistic journey
vocab_pack.definition_en: to give someone something that they need
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为现在分词 providing，作结果状语，后接 visitors with...，表示给访客提供独特的艺术之旅。
vocab_pack.example_en: The hotel provides guests with free Wi-Fi.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 酒店为客人提供免费无线网络。
vocab_pack.from_passage: providing visitors with a truly distinctive artistic journey

vocab_pack.definition_en: an office area that is used by multiple people or companies
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为名词短语，作介词 within 的宾语，表示在共享办公空间内。
vocab_pack.example_en: Freelancers often work in shared office spaces to save costs.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 自由职业者常在共享办公空间工作以节省成本。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Within the 2,000-square-meter shared office space

vocab_pack.definition_en: a machine that creates solid objects from a digital model by adding material layer by layer
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为复数形式 three-dimensional printers，与 live-streaming rooms 等并列，作主语补足语（被提供的事物）。
vocab_pack.example_en: Three-dimensional printers are used to prototype new designs.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 3D打印机用于制作新设计的原型。
vocab_pack.from_passage: facilities including three-dimensional printers

vocab_pack.definition_en: to satisfy the requirements of someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为不定式 to meet，作目的状语，后接宾语 the specific needs，表示为了满足远程工作者的特定需求。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new software was designed to meet the needs of small businesses.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这款新软件旨在满足小型企业的需求。
vocab_pack.from_passage: are provided to meet the specific needs

vocab_pack.definition_en: to work in a particular profession or to try to achieve a specific job
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 从事某种职业；追求职业发展
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为现在分词 pursuing，作后置定语修饰 remote workers，表示从事创造性设计、编程和媒体等职业的远程工作者。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many young people pursue careers in technology.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多年轻人从事科技行业。
vocab_pack.from_passage: remote workers typically pursuing careers such as creative design, programming and media

vocab_pack.definition_en: for example; used to give examples
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为固定短语，引出列举的具体职业：creative design, programming and media。
vocab_pack.example_en: He enjoys outdoor activities such as hiking and cycling.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他喜欢户外活动，比如徒步和骑行。
vocab_pack.from_passage: careers such as creative design, programming and media

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who works from a location outside of a traditional office, often from home or a coworking space
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为复数形式 remote workers，作主语补足语（被提供设施的对象），泛指远程工作者。
vocab_pack.example_en: Remote workers need a stable internet connection.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 远程工作者需要稳定的网络连接。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to meet the specific needs of the remote workers

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who works remotely using digital technology and often travels to different places
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 句中为复数形式 digital nomads，作主语，表示一类人。
vocab_pack.example_en: Digital nomads often choose locations with good internet and low cost of living.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 数字游民通常选择网络好、生活成本低的地方。
vocab_pack.from_passage: so many digital nomads have chosen to live and work here
